scientific_integrity: The claim concerns phase-only chiral adjacency quantum transport. General cone reduction and even-degree feasibility are credited to Frigerio and Paris. Novelty comparison is qualified by possible broader unit-gain results. Explicit analytic proof; finite checker is corroborative rather than exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple bicyclic bases, zero onsite potentials, all edge magnitudes one, and apex start only. No all-assignment classification for figure-eight graphs. Not independently audited.
title: Swift chiral quantum walks on cones over bicyclic graphs
